summary: Iteration 333 — Accounting Dashboard feature + P0 Team-menu regression verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering /dashboard, /dashboard/category-breakdown, /dashboard/category-transactions (invalid-tag 400, leaf & non-leaf descendant aggregation), CEO role permissions restored, and /transactions regression. Frontend: full CEO login → Admin module shows Team + Fleet + Product & SKU + Master Data groups; Accounting module shows Dashboard at top → /accounting/dashboard renders all 5 KPI cards (Money In ₹1.46Cr, Money Out ₹64.3L, Net ₹82.0L, Bills ₹2.5L, Untagged ₹16.0L with pulsing amber alert-ring), Cash Flow Trend chart, 3-level drilldown (Production & Manufacturing → Glass Bottles → 6 transactions), breadcrumb + back button work, Income tab switches to All Income ₹1.38Cr, period switcher (FY→Month→prev to May 2026 → non-zero ₹38L), Custom date inputs, Bills-Pending KPI navigates to /accounting/transactions, and /accounting/transactions regression still lists 33 rows.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountingDashboard.js line 69 silently swallows fetch errors (setData(null)) — consider surfacing the error message to help users distinguish 'no data' from 'API failure'.
CategoryDrilldown.jsx line 79 & 91 also swallow errors — no toast/log on axios failure.

Backend /dashboard aggregates 8 separate queries per request (2× dir_totals, 1× monthly, 2× count_total, 3× top-N, 1× bank agg + 2× category summaries + 2× masters). Fine for demo data (534 rows) but consider adding compound index on (tenant_id, date, direction) for production scale.
_bucket_node recursion in _category_level_summary walks the master tree per transaction; O(N*depth) — acceptable for current scale but could be pre-computed root_map for very large tenants.
kpi.money_in / money_out remain shaped as { total, count } so DashKpis is coupled to that shape — a Pydantic response model would help maintainability.
